reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin for routing specialized tasks, delegated agents, reviews, context compaction, vision, titles, and image generation to separately configured auxiliary models without replacing the main conversation model.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可独立配置的辅助模型路由，支持视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题和图像生成等任务。
summaries.en: Provides independently configured auxiliary model routes for DeepSeek Harness tasks including vision, context compaction, approval reviews, subagents, session titles, and image generation.

capabilities: Routes selected LLM calls to configured auxiliary models
Provides local image inspection and image handoff through vision models
Provides image generation through an OpenAI-compatible images API
